# SSToy decoder interoperability fixtures

Run the standard-library Python tests from the repository root:

```powershell
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_sstoy_decoder.py -v
```

The committed JSON is generated by the actual upstream binary packer and string
encoders. The TypeScript files contain unchanged excerpts from these pinned
sources; the generator strips type annotations with Node's built-in API:

- v3: https://github.com/JforPlay/sstoy/blob/34f57606015277cf9da76a2c7cc14fa1b68ccbbf/src/modules/app-saveload.ts
- historical v2: https://github.com/JforPlay/sstoy/blob/88e9aa3535e20a36e98e2a9928fcaa2065c94f42/src/modules/app-saveload.ts

Regenerate with Node 22.13 or newer, without npm packages:

```powershell
node tests/fixtures/generate_sstoy_fixtures.mjs
```

Only the compression adapter differs: Node's raw DEFLATE implementation replaces
fflate. The binary layout, Base91 encoding, and raw alphabet come from upstream.
Compressed bytes may differ from fflate's output while representing exactly the
same payload. Expected character IDs, custom potential order, levels, and sspp
priorities are explicit in the fixture generator. v2 uses upstream's frozen
legacy data lists rather than sspp's decoder maps. The JSON includes SHA-256
receipts for the two source excerpts, normal builds, malformed payloads, and an
independent Base91 byte vector containing the 14-bit branch.

The current upstream raw alphabet has 511 entries, but its encoder indexes by a
16-bit byte pair. Empty v2/v3 builds therefore produce `v2r-undefined𠀀` and
`v3r-undefined𠀀`: the version word has no alphabet entry. These URLs have already
lost bytes. Tests preserve this upstream behavior and require a clear decoder
error; they do not claim successful raw v2/v3 interoperability. The available
raw alphabet itself is decoded and tested without skipping invalid characters.
Legacy LZ-String URLs are explicitly unsupported; no runtime dependency is added.

SSToy mark 4 means minimum (명함만), so it maps to sspp priority 2. Unmarked
potentials also retain sspp's default priority 2. SSToy has no separate mark for
sspp's priority 3 (명함 필수).
